name: SafeHarbour Private Motor Insurance
disclaimer: FICTIONAL POLICY created for the PolicyGraph demo project. Not a real insurance product.

clauses.title: Insured vehicle
clauses.text: "Insured vehicle" means the private car shown on your schedule by its registration number.

clauses.title: Named driver
clauses.text: "Named driver" means any person listed by name as a driver on your schedule.

clauses.title: Social, domestic and pleasure purposes
clauses.text: "Social, domestic and pleasure purposes" means personal use such as shopping, visiting friends, holidays and leisure trips. It does not include any use in connection with a business or for payment.

clauses.title: Commuting
clauses.text: "Commuting" means travelling between your home and your single permanent place of work.

clauses.title: Business use
clauses.text: "Business use" means use of the insured vehicle in connection with any trade, profession or paid work, including delivering goods, food or parcels and visiting clients.

clauses.title: Third-party liability
clauses.text: We will cover your legal liability for death or injury to other people and for damage to their property caused by an accident involving the insured vehicle.

clauses.title: Fire and theft
clauses.text: We will cover loss of or damage to the insured vehicle caused by fire, theft or attempted theft.

clauses.title: Accidental damage
clauses.text: We will cover accidental damage to the insured vehicle, including damage caused in a collision, subject to the limitations in Sections 3 and 4 and the exclusions in Section 5.

clauses.title: Windscreen
clauses.text: We will cover the repair or replacement of broken windscreen and window glass. A windscreen claim does not affect your no-claims discount.

clauses.title: Permitted drivers
clauses.text: Cover applies only while the insured vehicle is driven by you or a named driver who holds a valid licence for the vehicle.

clauses.title: Permitted use
clauses.text: The insured vehicle may be used only for social, domestic and pleasure purposes and for commuting.

clauses.title: Business use
clauses.text: Business use is covered only if Business Use is shown on your schedule.

clauses.title: Unauthorised driver
clauses.text: We will not provide any cover while the insured vehicle is driven by a person who is not permitted to drive under clause 3.1. Where the law requires us to pay a third-party claim, we will pay it and recover the full amount from you.

clauses.title: Use for hire or reward
clauses.text: We will not provide any cover while the insured vehicle is used for hire or reward or for business use not shown on your schedule, including food delivery, parcel delivery or carrying passengers for payment. Where the law requires us to pay a third-party claim, we will pay it and recover the full amount from you.

clauses.title: Alcohol and drugs
clauses.text: We will not cover loss or damage to the insured vehicle while it is driven by a person over the legal alcohol limit or under the influence of drugs.

clauses.title: Racing and track days
clauses.text: We will not provide any cover while the insured vehicle is used for racing, speed testing or on a race track.

clauses.title: Mechanical failure
clauses.text: We will not cover mechanical, electrical or electronic breakdown, or wear and tear.

clauses.title: Reporting an accident
clauses.text: You must report any accident to us within 7 days and must not admit liability or agree to pay anyone without our written consent.

clauses.title: Excess
clauses.text: The standard excess for accidental damage claims is €300. An additional excess of €500 applies if the driver at the time of the accident was under 25 years of age.
